entities.name: Louis Leplée
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Leplée was a French nightclub owner who discovered French entertainer Édith Piaf, who was singing on a Paris street corner in 1935. Leplée starred Piaf at the popular Parisian nightspot Le Gerny's as "La Môme Piaf".
